question.nlq: I would like to know the names and prices of high-value products that have been ordered in a quantity of at least two units within a single order.
evidence: In this context, a product is defined as high-value if its product_price exceeds 10,000 (currency units).
A customer is classified as a Platinum member when the total amount spent across all orders exceeds 50,000 (currency units).

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, p.product_price
FROM Products AS p
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_price > 10000
  AND CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) >= 2;

question.nlq: I would like to know the three customers who have the highest total spending on orders that are marked as 'Completed' and that contain only products classified as Premium. Return each customer's ID, name, and the total amount spent.
evidence: A Regular customer is defined as a customer who has placed fewer than five orders in total.

A product is considered Premium if its product_price is greater than 10000. Total spending for a customer is defined as the sum over all qualifying orders of (product_price multiplied by the order_quantity of each item).

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH qualified_orders AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.customer_id
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
    GROUP BY co.order_id
    HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN p.product_price > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_name,
       SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spent
FROM qualified_orders qo
JOIN Order_Items oi ON qo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON qo.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

turns.sql:
WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
  FROM Customer_Orders o
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Completed'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
  HAVING MIN(p.product_price) > 10000
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
       SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS DECIMAL)) AS total_spent
FROM qualifying_orders qo
JOIN Order_Items oi ON qo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON qo.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH PremiumProducts AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE product_price > 10000
),
OrdersOnlyPremium AS (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM Customer_Orders o
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Completed'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_price <= 10000 THEN 1 END) = 0
),
CustomerSpending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
         SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spent
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
  JOIN OrdersOnlyPremium op ON co.order_id = op.order_id
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, total_spent
FROM CustomerSpending
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH premium_products AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE product_price > 10000
),
order_items_agg AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * p.product_price) AS order_total,
        COUNT(*) AS item_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_price > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premium_item_count
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
qualified_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        oi.order_total
    FROM Customer_Orders o
    JOIN order_items_agg oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Completed'
      AND oi.item_count = oi.premium_item_count
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    SUM(qo.order_total) AS total_spent
FROM qualified_orders qo
JOIN Customers c ON qo.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH premium_products AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE product_price > 10000
),
qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
  FROM Customer_Orders o
  JOIN (
    SELECT oi.order_id
    FROM Order_Items oi
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_price > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
  ) q ON o.order_id = q.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Completed'
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
       SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_spent
FROM qualifying_orders qo
JOIN Order_Items oi ON qo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON qo.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spending
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
AND co.order_id IN (
    SELECT oi2.order_id
    FROM Order_Items oi2
    JOIN Products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id
    GROUP BY oi2.order_id
    HAVING MIN(p2.product_price) > 10000
)
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH CompletedOrdersWithPremiumCheck AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) as order_total,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p.product_price <= 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_non_premium
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
    GROUP BY co.order_id, co.customer_id
),
ValidPremiumOrders AS (
    SELECT customer_id, order_total
    FROM CompletedOrdersWithPremiumCheck
    WHERE has_non_premium = 0
),
CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(order_total) as total_spending
    FROM ValidPremiumOrders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    ct.total_spending
FROM CustomerTotals ct
INNER JOIN Customers c ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ct.total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH Completed_Premium_Only_Orders AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.customer_id
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

)
SELECT

    SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) as total_spent
FROM Completed_Premium_Only_Orders po
JOIN Customers c ON po.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON po.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(p.product_price * oi.order_quantity) AS total_spending
FROM Customer_Orders co
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Order_Items oi2 JOIN Products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE oi2.order_id = co.order_id AND p2.product_price <= 10000
  )
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH premium_orders AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           co.order_id,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS order_total
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
      AND p.product_price > 10000
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, co.order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Order_Items oi2
        JOIN Products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id
        WHERE oi2.order_id = co.order_id
          AND p2.product_price > 10000
    )
),
customer_spending AS (

    FROM premium_orders po
    GROUP BY po.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_name,
       cs.total_spent
FROM customer_spending cs
JOIN Customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH premium_products AS (

    FROM Products
    WHERE product_price > 10000
),
qualified_orders AS (

SELECT c.customer_id,

FROM qualified_orders qo
JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = qo.order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = qo.customer_id

JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'

    )

WITH premium_orders AS (

JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = po.order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = po.customer_id

Premium loyalty program eligibility requires customers to have achieved a cumulative order value exceeding $75,000, where cumulative order value is calculated by summing the product of unit price multiplied by quantity ordered across all completed transactions for each customer.

question.nlq: Please generate a comprehensive report listing the full names and email addresses of all customers who satisfy the specific criteria for Gold Tier Client designation.
evidence: A customer qualifies for Gold Tier Client designation if the total number of their successfully completed orders places them within the top 20 percent of the entire customer base, calculated using the PERCENT_RANK window function ordered by order count in descending order.
Inventory adjustments for damaged goods are recorded daily at the end of each business day before the system backup runs.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH CustomerOrderCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        c.customer_email,
        COUNT(co.order_id) AS completed_order_count
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_name,
        customer_email,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC) AS tier_percentile
    FROM CustomerOrderCounts
)
SELECT 
    customer_name,
    customer_email
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE tier_percentile <= 0.2

turns.sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         c.customer_name,
         c.customer_email,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN co.order_status_code = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed_order_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC) AS pr
  FROM order_counts
)
SELECT customer_name, customer_email
FROM ranked
WHERE pr <= 0.2
ORDER BY customer_name;

  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email
),
ranked AS (

         customer_email,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC) AS pr
  FROM order_counts
)

  SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email,

  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_email

         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC) AS pr
  FROM order_counts

WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count
  FROM Customer_Orders
  WHERE order_status_code = 'Completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_stats AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name AS full_name, c.customer_email,
         COALESCE(o.completed_order_count, 0) AS order_count,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(o.completed_order_count, 0) DESC) AS pct_rank
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN completed_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
SELECT full_name, customer_email
FROM customer_stats
WHERE pct_rank <= 0.2;

question.nlq: Hey! So I'm trying to figure out which customers are our real VIPs here. Could you help me identify all those premium customers and pull their contact details? You know, the ones we should really take care of! I'd love to know their names, email addresses, and phone numbers so we can send them special offers. question.nlq: Could you please identify the products that are considered 'Market Leaders' and specify their sales rank within their respective categories?
evidence: 'Market Leaders' are defined as the top 3 performing products within each product_type_code based on the total quantity sold. The sales rank must be calculated using the DENSE_RANK() window function, partitioned by product_type_code and ordered by the sum of order_quantity in descending order. Note that order_quantity is stored as text and must be cast to an integer for aggregation.
Credit card payments processed through the system incur a standard 2.5% transaction fee which is deducted from the gross order total before accounting for net revenue.

WITH Product_Sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_type_code,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM Products p
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_type_code, p.product_name
),
Ranked_Products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        product_type_code,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM Product_Sales
)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    sales_rank
FROM Ranked_Products
WHERE sales_rank <= 3;
